questions.a: A technique to identify if a transaction was posted to the opposite side of an account by checking if the trial balance difference is divisible by two.

questions.a: Posting an entry to the wrong side doubles the error amount, creating a trial balance difference equal to twice the transaction value.

questions.a: A diagnostic check where a trial balance discrepancy divisible by nine indicates a possible transposition of digits or a misplaced decimal point.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Transposition Error Check'.
